title: [Bug] GLM-4.6v-Flash LoRA fine-tuning fails with NotImplementedError: get_input_embeddings
bodyExcerpt:
### Reminder

- [x] I have read the above rules and searched the existing issues.

### System Info

I have already updated my transformers >= 5.0.0rc0, but I still failed to lora finetune the glm4.6v.
below is my yaml file:
### model
model_name_or_path: /data/vlm-model/GLM-4.6V-Flash/
image_max_pixels: 262144
video_max_pixels: 16384
trust_remote_code: true

### method
stage: sft
do_train: true
finetuning_type: lora
lora_rank: 8
lora_target: all

### dataset
dataset: mllm_demo  # video: mllm_video_demo
template: glm4_5v
cutoff_len: 4096
max_samples: 1000
overwrite_cache: true
preprocessing_num_workers: 16
dataloader_num_workers: 4

### output
output_dir: saves/glm4_6v_flash/lora/sft
logging_steps: 10
save_steps: 500
plot_loss: true
overwrite_output_dir: true
save_only_model: false
report_to: wandb  # choices: [none, wandb, tensorboard, swanlab, mlflow]

### train
per_device_train_batch_size: 8
gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
learning_rate: 1.0e-4
num_train_epochs: 3.0
lr_scheduler_type: cosine
warmup_ratio: 0.1
bf16: true
ddp_timeout: 180000000
resume_from_checkpoint: null

### eval
val_size: 0.1
per_device_eval_batch_size: 1
eval_strategy: steps
eval_steps: 500
